Environment ready
Worked for 1m 14s

I've thoroughly explored the repository, and there is genuinely nothing to set up. The repo crispy-garbanzo (a GitHub auto-generated name) contains only a single file:

README.md with one line: # crispy-garbanzo

There is no application code, no services, no package manifests (package.json, requirements.txt, go.mod, etc.), no lockfiles, no language version files, no Dockerfiles, no CI config, and no setup scripts. Only main exists locally and on the remote, with a single Initial commit.

Because there is no product, no language toolchain, and no dependencies, there is nothing to install, no service to run in development mode, and no core functionality to exercise as a "hello world" task. Creating a toy application would be a fabricated/contrived artifact, which I won't do.

What I did:

✅ Inspected the full working tree and git state (git ls-files, git branch -a) — only README.md is tracked.
✅ Searched for any setup scripts, devcontainer configs, .cursor/environment.json, manifests, lockfiles, and version files — none exist.

I did not configure an update script because any script would be a meaningless no-op against the current repository state, and I did not add an AGENTS.md section because there are no real, durable run/test/build caveats to capture yet.

Summary
No development environment could be set up: the repository contains only README.md and no application code, services, or dependencies.

Testing

⚠️ No lint/test/build/run commands exist to execute — the repository has no code or tooling.

To proceed, please push the actual project code (or point me at the correct branch/repository). Once a product with a manifest or run instructions is present, I can install dependencies, configure the startup/update script, run the services, and demonstrate a real end-to-end task.

Environment is ready to be saved.
